title: Credential validation
text: When the user submits credentials, the QC software shall validate the credentials through the LDAP service.

title: Account lockout
text: If authentication fails three consecutive times, then the QC software shall lock the account for 15 minutes.

title: Configuration controls
text: While the current user lacks the Supervisor role, the QC software shall disable all configuration controls.

title: ASTM parsing
text: When an ASTM result record is received, the QC software shall parse the record and store it in the results database.

title: ASTM checksum
text: If an ASTM record fails checksum validation, then the QC software shall reject the record and log an error.

title: HL7 message generation
text: When a QC result is accepted, the QC software shall generate an HL7 v2.5 ORU^R01 message for the result.

title: HL7 retry
text: If the LIS does not acknowledge a message within 30 seconds, then the QC software shall retry the transmission up to 3 times.

title: Lot storage
text: The QC software shall store the lot number and expiry date in each QC material record.

title: Rule flagging
text: When a stored result violates a configured Westgard rule, the QC software shall set the result status to Flagged.

title: Chart rendering
text: When a QC result is stored, the QC software shall render the result on the Levey-Jennings chart within 5 seconds.

title: Flag notification
text: When a result is flagged, the QC software shall send a notification to the assigned user.

title: User action audit
text: The QC software shall write an audit record for every user action, including the timestamp and user ID.

title: Message audit
text: When an HL7 message is sent, the QC software shall write an audit record containing the message control ID.

title: PDF export
text: When the user selects Export, the QC software shall generate a PDF of the selected audit records.

title: Chart readability
text: The Levey-Jennings charts should be easy to read.

title: Result processing
text: When a result is received, the QC software shall process the result promptly.

title: Legacy CSV export
text: The QC software shall export results in the legacy CSV format.

title: Expiry validation
text: When a lot record is saved, the QC software shall validate that the expiry date is in the future.
